description: Poor legacy data quality slows migration and lowers reconciliation
response: Mitigate: data profiling and cleansing sprint before each wave, depot data owners

description: Integration with the legacy ERP fails at cutover (billing, parts)
response: Mitigate: end-to-end integration tests every sprint, cutover rehearsal per wave

description: Open tickets lost or corrupted during migration
response: Avoid: reconciliation gate at 99.5% and 0 open tickets lost before go-live

description: Technicians resist the new mobile app
response: Mitigate: 2+ super-users per depot, hands-on training, floor support in hypercare

description: Vendor resourcing gaps during overlapping waves
response: Mitigate: named resources in the SOW, escalation path to vendor account lead

description: Wave 4 overlaps the holiday period; Wave 3 slip compresses Wave 4
response: Mitigate: fixed Dec 18 deadline, buffer week, re-plan if Wave 3 is NO-GO

description: Cutover downtime exceeds 4 hours per depot
response: Mitigate: timed rehearsals, parallel load, rollback trigger at 3.5 hours

description: Security rejects SSO or data-residency model
response: Avoid: security review gate before Wave 1

description: Unsupported legacy system fails before decommissioning
response: Accept with contingency: nightly read-only backup, vendor-independent DB access

description: Budget overrun from extra cleansing sprints and Wave 3 re-test
response: Mitigate: draw from 10% contingency, monthly review with Finance

description: Depot key users unavailable for UAT during peak season
response: Mitigate: book UAT slots 4 weeks ahead, backup key users per depot

description: Billing errors after go-live delay the financial close
response: Mitigate: billing reconciliation in hypercare, finance sign-off on integration tests

description: DEF-100 fix incomplete or other dirty depot codes drop open tickets in later loads
response: Avoid: trim and validate depot codes (MSM-52), apply to Wave 4 mock load (MSM-54)

description: DEF-112: Wave 1-2 work orders closed after migration were never invoiced
response: Mitigate: fix DEF-112 (MSM-58), reconcile and back-bill Wave 1-2 work orders

description: Wave 3 NO-GO: fixes and UAT re-test not done by Nov 18 push cutover into December
response: Mitigate: daily triage (MSM-52, MSM-58), UAT re-test (MSM-61), revised plan (MSM-66)
